chassis.description: chassis_i describes the length of the chassis in the x, y, z axis, pos_i the center of mass of the chassis

motors.description: The two wheel motors, both alike. The SIMULATION backend models a DC gear motor with an encoder and its speed controller. For real motors on a board, create MQTT motors and attach them with set_motor()

sensors.description: The sensors of the robot. Leave the sensors attribute empty if no sensors. Or set all flags enble to false

front-sonar.description: An ultrasonic range sensor on the front of the chassis that looks ahead, like an HC-SR04: it measures from min_distance to max_distance, in metres, and hears echoes from a cone beam_angle degrees wide, simulated with n_rays rays. frame_pos is where it sits relative to the centre of the chassis. The backend is SIMULATION, or MQTT for a real sensor, with broker and topic
front-sonar.name: FrontSonar

line-sensor.description: Infrared reflectance elements under the front of the chassis that look at the floor, like TCRT5000 modules. Each reads the reflectance under it, from 0 for black to 1 for white; below threshold it is over a dark line. elements are their positions relative to the centre of the chassis, left to right. The backend is SIMULATION, or MQTT for real elements, with broker and topic
line-sensor.name: LineSensor

imu.description: An accelerometer and a gyroscope on top of the chassis, like an MPU-6050, with its axes along the chassis. It reads the specific force in m/s^2 and the angular velocity in rad/s. The SIMULATION backend adds the gyro_bias, in rad/s, and normal noise of standard deviation gyro_noise and accel_noise to every reading. The backend is SIMULATION, or MQTT for a real IMU, with broker and topic
imu.name: IMU

front-camera.description: A camera that looks straight down at the floor ahead. offset is how far ahead of the axle centre the middle of its view is, view_length and view_width the size of the floor it sees along and across the robot, all in metres. image_width and image_height are the size of its image in pixels, update_rate the images per second
front-camera.name: FrontCamera
